styleLock.direction: airy maternal baby-body-care commerce, soft skincare-infographic ecommerce
styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless airy white #FFFFFF studio field plus one pale blush-pink band #FBE7E3 carrying the type; one bright domestic bedroom field with white terry bedding for the lifestyle screen; flat colour panels only, no scenic cut-outs, no stock-photo haze
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright airy high-key soft daylight key from front-left, wide bounce fill on the shadow side, one clean elongated highlight band across the polished lid, soft contact shadow only, never hard specular, colour temperature around 5600K
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte white paper sweep and pale blush board #FBE7E3; soft white terry bedding and a pale cushion #F1EAE2 for the lifestyle screen; matte ceramic dish #F4F1EC for loose powder; the only gloss in the set is the metal lid
styleLock.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif family; bold azure #2F7FC1 headline with charcoal #2D2D2D body and an optional coral #E4574C emphasis span, letter-spaced small eyebrow line, one dotted-border rounded callout badge; headline, subline and caption sizes identical across the whole set
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line glyphs centred inside soft blush filled circles #F7D9D3, one short caption per icon, all icons on one shared baseline, never cartoon or 3D
styleLock.presentationRules: the jar is always a low squat frosted glass body with a wide polished chrome band lid, lid seam perfectly horizontal, never tilted, never re-proportioned; product scale stable across shots and grounded by a soft contact shadow; the label face stays a blank legible field carrying no wordmark; powder appears only as a still mound or one small contained puff at the jar mouth, never as a wide airborne cloud and never near a face
noDrift: no brand wordmark, stock-site mark or placeholder logo restyled into the label
no cure, treatment or prevention wording for any medical or skin condition, including prickly-heat naming
no age indication, no ingredient percentage, no net-weight figure, no registration or filing number, no laboratory, hospital or authority endorsement
no talc-free or additive-free assertion rendered as copy
no wide airborne powder cloud near any face
no identifiable infant face; any baby stays anonymous and calmly supervised

provenance.notes: 由 5 张详情页切片提炼，只保留镜头角色、机位、光位、材质语言与信息图布局。逐片判读：矮圆磨砂玻璃粉罐配宽抛光金属盖（罐身所印 DW 与下方中英文字样是素材站占位标，源图为可编辑模板而非真实在售包装），配玉米棒与玉米粒意象、四枚圆形功能图标、编号分区婴儿图与产品介绍表，故按图判定为 L1 母婴 / L2 洗护 的婴儿玉米基舒爽粉，而非成人身体护理。已剥离：全部源文案（驱痱防疹、赶走痱子、预防痱子、止痒、抑菌、不含滑石粉、四季皆宜、适合人群等医疗与功效断言一律改由 {selling_point_*}/{callout_*} 占位，并在 noDrift 与每条 Negative 中禁用）、素材站与店铺标识及占位 logo、FDA 与 GMP 式徽标与备案字样、产品名称与容量克重、产地与经销商、保质期、含百分比的成分表；婴儿与母亲一律匿名化（背对、裁掉下颌以上）并保持平静看护；粉体只作静置小堆或罐口一处受控轻扬，绝不在面部附近成云。商品本体以 {product} 注入，罐型、金属盖、磨砂质感与标签位置跟随参考图，标签面留作空白可读区域。
